name: Bardonecchia Alpine Coaster
editorial: Eight rewritten descriptions, age 4 minimum, accompaniment under eight with age and height criteria, displayed winter fares in six structured offers, summer 2026 fares in notes. No winter 2026/27 opening dates inferred from ski resort schedule.
pricing: Official winter attraction page currently displays adult €7/€14/€20/€39/€60 for 1/2/3/6/10 runs; under-eight single €6. The official explicitly labeled summer 2026 schedule lists €6/€12/€17/€33/€50 and €5. Winter page does not show an explicit tariff effective date; verify at booking.
hours: Official summer hours page still shows September weekends 10:00–18:00, weather permitting. No attraction-specific winter 2026/27 hours are published. No winter schedule or closures invented.
